name: Bith

attributes.attribute: was the son of the biblical Noah

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Bith is an Irish hero or god, the son of Noah, and the father of Cesair. Cesair was the first settler of Ireland and fled the flood in her own ark. Bith came with her and landed in Munster. He later joined seventeen of Cesair's handmaidens to move to Ulster. Bith died on Slieve Beagh.

okr.objective: Show Bith as an Irish hero or god who was the son of Noah and father of Cesair.
key_results: Bith was the son of the biblical Noah.
He was the father of Cesair, the first settler of Ireland.
He landed in Munster and died on Slieve Beagh.
